assumptions.choice: Weekly OHLCV bars are manually aggregated from the single daily feed; volume is summed, open is the first daily open, high/low are weekly extrema, and close is the final trading close.
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies only one daily data feed and strategy code cannot add a Cerebro resampled feed.

assumptions.choice: A week is completed on Friday when available; if no Friday bar exists, it is completed when the next ISO week begins.
assumptions.reason: This preserves the final available trading bar as the weekly close.

assumptions.choice: Orders are submitted when the weekly close becomes known and use Backtrader's normal order execution behavior.
assumptions.reason: Without harness-controlled cheat-on-close, a strategy cannot guarantee execution at the already-observed weekly closing price.

assumptions.choice: The percentage stop-loss and take-profit thresholds are evaluated using each completed weekly close.
assumptions.reason: The strategy specification defines a weekly-timeframe strategy and does not specify intrabar stop orders or daily monitoring.

assumptions.choice: The six-week holding period is measured as six completed weekly bars after the entry order is filled.
assumptions.reason: The specification states a time stop after six weeks but does not define a different calendar-day convention.
